name: study-microbit-with-test
description: micro:bit 学習プロジェクト

scripts.lint:ts: cd sample-compass-ts && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -1 || echo '✓ TypeScript OK'
scripts.lint:python: cd sample-compass && uv run python -m py_compile compass.py conftest.py && echo '✓ Python OK'
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:makecode
scripts.test:python: cd sample-compass && uv run pytest test_compass.py -v
scripts.e2e:python: cd sample-compass && uv run pytest e2e_test_compass.py -v
scripts.build:hex:python: cd sample-compass && uv run python build_hex.py
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:ts
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:python && npm run e2e:ts
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run e2e
scripts.build:hex: npm run build:hex:python && npm run build:hex:ts
